concerns.text: FR-012 (baseline handling) is not explicitly addressed by any phase, task, or contract in the implementation plan. The plan mentions reconstruction of effect sizes but does not state the heuristic of using the average of the two variant rates when a baseline conversion rate is missing.

SC-001 (extraction accuracy ≥ 95 % on a manually annotated validation set) is not linked to any task or phase. The plan includes tasks T081/T082 for extraction validation (precision/recall/F1) but does not specify the overall extraction‑accuracy metric required by SC-001.

SC-014 (binomial test must report p‑value rounded to three decimals, Wilson CI width ≤ 0.10, and flag significance at p ≤ 0.05) is not referenced in any implementation step. Phase 2 I05 performs the binomial test, but the required reporting format and CI width constraint are absent.

SC-015 (sensitivity analysis variation must be < 0.02 across baseline proportions 0.02–0.10) is not mentioned in the plan. Phase 2 I05 includes a sensitivity sweep, yet the acceptable variation threshold is not captured in any task or success‑criterion.
